text: In an effort to foster cross-cultural understanding on campus, the International Cultural Exchange Week will be grandly hosted from December 1st to 7th.
This notice is issued for the purpose of recruiting 20 energetic and responsible student volunteers.
Prospective candidates are expected to fulfill the following qualifications.
Above all, applicants should demonstrate fluent oral English communication skills and basic cultural sensitivity.
In addition, prior volunteer experience and strong teamwork spirit will be viewed favorably.
The primary responsibilities entail guiding international guests, coordinating exhibition booths, and facilitating cultural workshops.
Those who are interested should submit an electronic application to volunteer_exchange@university.edu.cn before November 20th.
We sincerely look forward to your active participation.
